description: The plot illustrates the training accuracy across epochs for three different methods on a synthetic dataset. The x-axis represents the "Epoch" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 400, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 50. The y-axis represents the "Training Accuracy" on a linear scale, extending from slightly below 0.2 up to 1.0, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2 and corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines. The plot features three solid lines without markers, identified by a legend. The "Linear" line, colored light blue, begins near an accuracy of 0.1 at epoch 0, exhibits a rapid and slightly noisy ascent to reach 1.0 near epoch 60, and remains constant at 1.0 for the remainder of the x-axis up to epoch 400. The "C$^3$A$_{b=128/2}$" line, colored pink, starts near 0.15 at epoch 0, climbs with a period of high, dense fluctuation between epochs 50 and 100, reaches 1.0 shortly after epoch 100, and terminates early around epoch 175 at a value of 1.0. The "LoRA$_{r=1}$" line, colored greyish-blue, starts near 0.1 at epoch 0 and demonstrates a highly erratic but generally upward trend, reaching approximately 0.9 by epoch 300. It then undergoes a sharp, volatile decline, hitting a visible low near 0.45 around epoch 360, before climbing back with continuing large oscillations to finish at approximately 0.95 at epoch 400.
